method: Accelerated COMPLETE production frame, explicit dt .25 s, normal input vector, real controllers/collisions/streaming/audio/rig. Rendering only at checkpoints; not a native film or FPS test. Diagnostic source-road placement only BEFORE traversal except spawn which is untouched. No position assignment or collider alteration during travel.

route.clearance: source topology and access checked; local 3D support/collisions still required; no connector implied

character.receiver: landscape only; actor receives landscape map

planet.floatingOrigin: integrated render/audio origin; canonical simulation and storage unchanged

transport.provenance: Synthetic traffic on imported OSM infrastructure; no real timetable, flight or passenger service.

traffic.provenance: Deterministic scenic vehicles on admitted OSM roads; no live traffic

admission.source: IGN LHD numeric MNT; 2 m derivative
admission.provenance: OSM road corridor + declared regional access policy; inferred width when absent

buffers.scope: CPU mirrors of loaded geometry and typed textures; excludes driver allocation, compression, render targets and untyped image textures
